notes: New: a high-quality male voice is now the default for every reminder.
New: Settings > Voice > Voice model lists the voices installed on your phone so you can lock in the best male voice and keep it for every alert.
Improved: a real male voice is left at its natural pitch instead of being slowed down, so it sounds clearer and less robotic.
Improved: if the chosen voice cannot speak, the app tries the next-best male voice before falling back to the phone default.
Removed: the floating + button has been removed for a cleaner screen. Use Add on the Schedule tab.
